$comment: The look measured from the reference reels in samples/ (2026-10-27, see samples/STYLE.md). Captions: Europa Grotesk SH Bold (the creator's font) one line at the frame's centre, lowercase with names kept; keywords as whole groups in Tactic Sans Ultra Italic caps, in colour. Both fonts are the creator's licensed copies (gitignored): copy them from the system font folder into presets/vertical/default/fonts/. Framing: face width ~0.26 of the frame, face centre at 0.33 of the height. Louder master.

framing.$comment: the samples' face is ~0.255 of the frame wide, centred at 0.33 of the height (measured over all 8): face_w sets the crop from the raw's own median face, so a wide raw is cropped in more
